description: This file defines a PHP class 'FormatWithLanguage' which implements a value formatter interface to retrieve and format language names based on language IDs, utilizing a LanguageService for data access.

classes.name: FormatWithLanguage
classes.description: A class that formats language IDs into language names using a dedicated language service.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the language name for a given language ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getLanguageService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the LanguageService instance used to fetch language data.
